description: English-language experiment (mirror of v4.3): same knowledge test, prompts and mushroom names in English, reference = ethalon-en.json. v4.3-en rev.2: полностью англоязычный system-промпт и EN-ключи JSON-контракта (mushroom/composition/compound/amount/effect, format-схема OUTPUT_SCHEMA_EN, парсер понимает их через KEY_ALIASES) + явное 'Answer in English'. Причина: в рев.1 русский токены контракта («содержание», «влияние», «неизвестно») перетягивали язык ответа — 47–100% названий в EN-серии были кириллицей (архив: archive/en-run1-contaminated). Answer language is part of the experiment, not part of the measured knowledge.
system_prompt: You are taking a test on your knowledge of the chemical composition of mushrooms. Answer strictly in JSON using exactly these keys: {"mushroom": "...", "composition": [{"compound": "...", "amount": "...", "effect": "..."}]}. In "amount" give a number with a unit (% of fresh weight, % of dry weight, mg/kg, mg/g, or per fruiting body) — if you do not know, write "unknown". In "effect" give one short sentence about the compound's effect on humans. List the main chemical compounds of this mushroom. Answer in English. No text outside the JSON.

questions.prompt: List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of fly agaric (Amanita muscaria).
List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of panther cap (Amanita pantherina).
List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of death cap (Amanita phalloides).
List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of false death cap (Amanita citrina).
List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of blusher (Amanita rubescens).
List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of Caesar's mushroom (Amanita caesarea).
List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of destroying angel (Amanita virosa).
List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of honey fungus (Armillaria mellea).
